title: Sales opportunity
description: One potential sale in the venture's pipeline, at sales/opportunities/<id>.json (route sales/opportunities/[id]): from first interest (a lead) to won or lost. It follows the CRM practice of APQC PCF 3.5.1 (develop and manage sales opportunities), with MEDDIC qualification fields and a win-loss reason once closed. The marketing and sales function owns it, and only the marketing and sales agent (role marketing-and-sales-agent) or a person writes it (writer function in packages/naive/src/records/data-model.json). The buyer is named by reference to an account or customer record, never by contact details.

id.description: The opportunity's id, the file name without .json

title.description: What is being sold to whom, in a few words

account.description: The buying party by reference: the id of an account record (accounts/<id>/account.json)

customer.description: The customer record (customers/<id>.json) once the opportunity is won

icp.description: The ideal customer profile it fits, by foundation/icp id

pipeline_stage.description: lead: interest shown, not yet qualified. qualified: the economic buyer, decision criteria and a reason to act now are known. proposal: an offer was sent. negotiation: terms are being agreed. won or lost: closed

source.description: How the opportunity reached the venture

channel.description: The traction channel it came through, such as search, a community or a conference (Weinberg and Mares, Traction)

created.description: When the interest was first recorded

first_response.description: When the venture first replied; null while no one has. Inbound leads are answered within an hour (Oldroyd, McElheran and Elkington, HBR 2011)

value.description: What the deal is expected to be worth

expected_close.description: When the deal is expected to close

qualification.description: MEDDIC qualification, each field what is known so far. An opportunity enters a forecast only when economic_buyer, decision_criteria and pain are known

metrics.description: The gain the buyer expects, in their numbers

economic_buyer.description: The role that can say yes to the money

decision_criteria.description: How the buyer will judge the options

decision_process.description: The steps and people between now and a signature

pain.description: The problem that makes them act now

champion.description: The role inside the buyer who argues for the venture

next_step.description: The next agreed action and its date

outcome.description: Why it was won or lost, for a closed opportunity (win-loss analysis)

reason.description: The main reason, in a sentence

category.description: The kind of reason, so reasons can be counted

from.description: Who gave the reason: the buyer in a win-loss interview, or the seller's own account

competitor.description: The competitor record id that won or lost against the venture, when there was one

owner.description: Who works the opportunity: a person or a role id
